pre.name: precopy-ucscfg.sh
pre.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -ux

DISK_REF="DISK_NAME_PLACEHOLDER"
NODE="$(readlink -f "$DISK_REF" || true)"
[ -n "$NODE" ] || NODE="$DISK_REF"

TYPE="$(lsblk -nro TYPE "$NODE" 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)"
if [ "$TYPE" = "disk" ]; then
  SRC_PART="$(lsblk -nrpo PATH,TYPE "$NODE" | awk '$2=="part"{print $1; exit}')"
else
  SRC_PART="$NODE"
fi

mkdir -p /tmp/scu_src /tmp
if ! mount -o ro "$SRC_PART" /tmp/scu_src; then
  echo "CRITICAL: Failed to mount $SRC_PART"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Copying files from source media..."

cp -f /tmp/scu_src/tmp/ucscfg /tmp/ucscfg 2>/dev/null || \
cp -f /tmp/scu_src/ucscfg /tmp/ucscfg 2>/dev/null || \
echo "ucscfg not found, skipping"

cp -f /tmp/scu_src/sles_post_script.sh /sles_post_script.sh 2>/dev/null || \
cp -f /tmp/scu_src/tmp/sles_post_script.sh /sles_post_script.sh 2>/dev/null || \
echo "sles_post_script.sh not found, skipping"

cp -f /tmp/scu_src/tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh 2>/dev/null || \
cp -f /tmp/scu_src/sles_nwconfig.sh /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh 2>/dev/null || \
echo "sles_nwconfig.sh not found, skipping"

cp -f /tmp/scu_src/tmp/adapterList /tmp/adapterList 2>/dev/null || \
cp -f /tmp/scu_src/adapterList /tmp/adapterList 2>/dev/null || \
echo "adapterList not found, skipping"

if [ -d /tmp/scu_src/update ]; then
  cp -rf /tmp/scu_src/update /update && echo "update folder copied"
elif [ -d /tmp/scu_src/tmp/update ]; then
  cp -rf /tmp/scu_src/tmp/update /update && echo "update folder copied"
else
  echo "update folder not found, skipping"
fi

umount /tmp/scu_src

chmod 755 /tmp/ucscfg 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 755 /sles_post_script.sh 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 755 /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 644 /tmp/adapterList 2>/dev/null || true
[ -d /update ] && chmod -R 755 /update 2>/dev/null || true

echo "Precopy script completed successfully"

post.name: install.sh
post.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -x
exec > /tmp/install_debug.log 2>&1

echo "=== INSTALL.SH STARTED ==="
date
echo "Current directory: $(pwd)"
echo "Current user: $(whoami)"

echo "\n=== CHECKING SOURCE FILES ==="
ls -la /tmp/ | grep -E '(ucscfg|sles|adapter)' || echo "No matching files in /tmp"
ls -la / | grep -E '(sles|ucscfg|update)' || echo "No matching files in /"

echo "\n=== MOUNT INFORMATION ==="
mount | grep -v tmpfs

echo "\n=== LOOKING FOR TARGET ROOT ==="
for POSSIBLE_ROOT in /mnt /target /a /tmp/root /install; do
  echo "Checking: $POSSIBLE_ROOT"
  if [ -d "$POSSIBLE_ROOT" ]; then
    echo "  Directory exists"
    ls -la "$POSSIBLE_ROOT" | head -10
    if mountpoint -q "$POSSIBLE_ROOT" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "  *** IS A MOUNTPOINT ***"
      TARGET_ROOT="$POSSIBLE_ROOT"
      break
    fi
  fi
done

if [ -z "$TARGET_ROOT" ]; then
  echo "\n=== NO MOUNTPOINT FOUND, CHECKING FOR MOUNTED FILESYSTEMS ==="
  mount | grep -E '(ext4|xfs|btrfs)' | grep -v '(loop|tmpfs)'
  TARGET_ROOT=$(mount | grep -E 'on /mnt' | head -1 | awk '{print $3}')
  echo "Extracted from mount: $TARGET_ROOT"
fi

TARGET_ROOT="${TARGET_ROOT:-/mnt}"
echo "\n=== USING TARGET_ROOT: $TARGET_ROOT ==="

echo "\n=== CREATING TARGET DIRECTORIES ==="
mkdir -pv "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp"
ls -lad "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp"

echo "\n=== COPYING FILES ==="

if [ -f /tmp/ucscfg ]; then
  echo "Copying /tmp/ucscfg..."
  cp -fv /tmp/ucscfg "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/ucscfg" && chmod -v 777 "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/ucscfg"
  ls -la "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/ucscfg"
else
  echo "NOTICE: /tmp/ucscfg NOT FOUND (skipping)"
fi

if [ -f /sles_post_script.sh ]; then
  echo "Copying /sles_post_script.sh..."
  cp -fv /sles_post_script.sh "${TARGET_ROOT}/sles_post_script.sh" && chmod -v 755 "${TARGET_ROOT}/sles_post_script.sh"
  ls -la "${TARGET_ROOT}/sles_post_script.sh"
else
  echo "NOTICE: /sles_post_script.sh NOT FOUND (skipping)"
fi

if [ -f /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh ]; then
  echo "Copying /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh..."
  cp -fv /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh" && chmod -v 755 "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh"
  ls -la "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh"
else
  echo "NOTICE: /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh NOT FOUND (skipping)"
fi

if [ -f /tmp/adapterList ]; then
  echo "Copying /tmp/adapterList..."
  cp -fv /tmp/adapterList "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/adapterList" && chmod -v 644 "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/adapterList"
  ls -la "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/adapterList"
else
  echo "NOTICE: /tmp/adapterList NOT FOUND (skipping)"
fi

if [ -d /update ]; then
  echo "Copying /update folder..."
  cp -rfv /update "${TARGET_ROOT}/update" && chmod -Rv 755 "${TARGET_ROOT}/update"
  echo "Contents of ${TARGET_ROOT}/update:"
  ls -la "${TARGET_ROOT}/update" | head -20
else
  echo "NOTICE: /update folder NOT FOUND (skipping)"
fi

[ -f /tmp/nslist ] && cp -fv /tmp/nslist "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/nslist" || true
[ -f /tmp/routes_list ] && cp -fv /tmp/routes_list "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/routes_list" || true

echo "\n=== FINAL VERIFICATION ==="
echo "Contents of ${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp:"
ls -la "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/" || echo "Cannot list ${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp"

echo "Contents of ${TARGET_ROOT} root:"
ls -la "${TARGET_ROOT}/" | head -20

echo "\n=== INSTALL.SH COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY ==="
date

cp -f /tmp/install_debug.log "${TARGET_ROOT}/tmp/install_debug.log" 2>/dev/null || true

post.name: chroot.sh
post.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -x
exec > /tmp/chroot_debug.log 2>&1

echo "=== CHROOT SCRIPT STARTED ==="
date
echo "Current directory: $(pwd)"
echo "Current user: $(whoami)"

echo "\n=== CHECKING FOR FILES IN CHROOT ==="
ls -la /tmp/ | grep -E '(ucscfg|sles|adapter)' || echo "No matching files in /tmp"
ls -la / | grep -E '(ucscfg|sles|update)' || echo "No matching files in /"

echo "\n=== LOOKING FOR INSTALLER FILESYSTEM ==="
for INSTALLER_PATH in /mnt/install /install /installer /media; do
  if [ -d "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp" ]; then
    echo "Found installer at: $INSTALLER_PATH"
    ls -la "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp/" | grep -E '(ucscfg|sles|adapter)' || true
    ls -la "$INSTALLER_PATH/" | grep -E '(sles|update)' || true

    [ -f "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp/ucscfg" ] && cp -fv "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp/ucscfg" /tmp/ucscfg && chmod 777 /tmp/ucscfg || true
    [ -f "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh" ] && cp -fv "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh" /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh && chmod 755 /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh || true
    [ -f "$INSTALLER_PATH/sles_post_script.sh" ] && cp -fv "$INSTALLER_PATH/sles_post_script.sh" /sles_post_script.sh && chmod 755 /sles_post_script.sh || true
    [ -f "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp/adapterList" ] && cp -fv "$INSTALLER_PATH/tmp/adapterList" /tmp/adapterList && chmod 644 /tmp/adapterList || true

    if [ -d "$INSTALLER_PATH/update" ] && [ ! -d /update ]; then
      echo "Copying update folder from installer..."
      cp -rfv "$INSTALLER_PATH/update" /update && chmod -R 755 /update || echo "Failed to copy update folder"
    fi
  fi
done

echo "\n=== FILES AFTER COPY ATTEMPT ==="
ls -la /tmp/ | grep -E '(ucscfg|sles|adapter)' || echo "No matching files in /tmp"
ls -la / | grep -E '(sles|update)' || echo "No matching files in /"
if [ -d /update ]; then
  echo "Update folder contents:"
  ls -la /update | head -10
else
  echo "No update folder present"
fi

post_rc=0
nw_rc=0

echo "\n=== EXECUTING SLES POST SCRIPT ==="
if [ -f /sles_post_script.sh ]; then
  chmod +x /sles_post_script.sh
  /sles_post_script.sh
  post_rc=$?
  if [ "$post_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "sles_post_script failed with code $post_rc" >> /tmp/ucscfg_status.log
  fi
else
  echo "NOTICE: /sles_post_script.sh not found (skipping)" >> /tmp/ucscfg_status.log
fi

echo "\n=== EXECUTING SLES NETWORK CONFIG ==="
if [ -f /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh ]; then
  chmod +x /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh
  /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh
  nw_rc=$?
  if [ "$nw_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "sles_nwconfig failed with code $nw_rc" >> /tmp/ucscfg_status.log
  fi
else
  echo "NOTICE: /tmp/sles_nwconfig.sh not found (skipping)" >> /tmp/ucscfg_status.log
fi

echo "\n=== CONFIGURING NETWORK ==="
ns_list=$(cat /tmp/nslist 2>/dev/null || true)
for word in $ns_list; do
  echo "nameserver $word" >> /etc/resolv.conf
done
if [ -f /tmp/routes_list ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    echo "$line" >> /etc/sysconfig/network/routes
  done < /tmp/routes_list
else
  echo "NOTICE: /tmp/routes_list not found (skipping route configuration)"
fi

if [ "$post_rc" -ne 0 ] || [ "$nw_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "One or more post-install scripts failed (post_rc=$post_rc, nw_rc=$nw_rc)" >> /tmp/ucscfg_status.log
  exit 1
fi

chmod 777 /tmp/ucscfg
echo 'OS INSTALL COMPLETED' >> /tmp/status
/tmp/ucscfg os-completed-status '/tmp/status'


echo "\n=== CHROOT SCRIPT COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY ==="
date
